newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenia's Kolinska sees steady dividend.
newsitem.headline: Slovenia's Kolinska sees steady dividend.

text.p: Slovenian food producer Kolinska said on Tuesday it expected to pay an unchanged dividend of 82.66 tolars ($0.54) per share for the third consecutive year in spite of a decline in net profit.
Kolinska said its unconsolidated net profit fell to 560.4 million tolars ($3.6 million) from 647.0 million last year. It blamed the drop on a change in accounting procedures.

"We decided to propose an unchanged dividend in order to please shareholders. The proposal has to be approved at a shareholders' meeting in July," Kolinska's marketing manager Milena Stular told Reuters.
Sales rose to 9.5 billion tolars ($61.6 million) from 7.9 billion, while exports were up at 2.8 billion tolars from 2.2 billion, the company said.
Kolinska owns four production plants and trading companies in Slovenia, three in other successor states of the former Yugoslavia and one in Germany.
The company said its consolidated business results would be available at the end of March.
Kolinska's shares fell 2.6 percent to 2,172 tolars on the Ljubljana bourse on Tuesday. -- Marja Novak, Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
